scope: Completed RIO Matrix reports, figures, measured scalar summaries, validation and execution provenance; excludes raw models, optimizer states, corpora, fitted basis arrays and caches.
bounded_scalar_npz_policy: Only finite numeric minibatch loss summaries, each under 1 MiB; no parameter arrays.
additional_csv_line_endings_note: Preserve validated CSV bytes, including standard CRLF; do not rewrite scientific inputs for whitespace normalization.
